readings.oracle: The oracle key sets the weight of each outcome: a fail is strong, and a pass is an upper bound.
readings.L1: on a formulaic, name-heavy seal corpus a true reading does not beat its shuffles. Fit-refute has no stated power on seal legends at 1.6 x Indus excess. It does not decide Indus-level corpora. Cause not separated (excess, names missing from the lexicon, lexicon period).
